name: fineract-hasura-mono-repo
description: Fineract mono-repo with Hasura backend and Next.js frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n postgres,hasura,frontend "npm run postgres:dev" "npm run hasura:dev" "npm run frontend:dev"
scripts.hasura:dev: npm run hasura:migrate && npm run hasura:metadata && docker-compose -f docker-compose-hasura.yml up hasura
scripts.hasura:migrate: cd hasura && hasura migrate apply --endpoint http://localhost:8080 --admin-secret myadminsecretkey --database-name default
scripts.hasura:metadata: cd hasura && hasura metadata apply --endpoint http://localhost:8080 --admin-secret myadminsecretkey
scripts.hasura:console: cd hasura && hasura console --endpoint http://localhost:8080 --admin-secret myadminsecretkey
